title: Event-Driven Commerce
summary: In-memory event bus, commerce event producers/consumers, event log endpoint, and replay demo.

extra_tests.tests/test_events.py:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
                from app.main import app

                client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

                def test_event_log_after_product_search():
                    client.get('/products', params={'query': 'pasta'})
                    response = client.get('/events')
                    assert response.status_code == 200
                    assert any(event['event_type'] == 'product_viewed' for event in response.json()['items'])
